entities.name: DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address
entities.description: Information element containing the MAC address of the DS-TT Ethernet port. It is included when the UE supports transfer of port management information containers and requests to establish a new Ethernet PDU session.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The user equipment that supports transfer of port management information containers and requests establishment of Ethernet PDU sessions.

entities.name: Ethernet PDU session
entities.description: A PDU session of Ethernet type that the UE requests to establish.

entities.name: Port management information container support
entities.description: Condition indicating that the UE supports transfer of port management information containers.

entities.name: New Ethernet PDU session request
entities.description: Condition where the UE requests to establish a new PDU session of Ethernet type.

relations.description: The inclusion of DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address IE is guarded by the condition that the UE supports port management information container transfer.
The inclusion of DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address IE is guarded by the condition that the UE requests to establish a new Ethernet PDU session.
The UE establishes the condition of supporting port management information container transfer.
The UE establishes the condition of requesting a new Ethernet PDU session.
